description: This source file defines a 'User' entity class in a Java-based e-commerce application, representing user accounts with fields for credentials, personal info, and relationships to other entities like groups, merchant store, and language. It includes annotations for ORM mapping and auditing.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system with credentials, personal info, and relationships to groups, merchant store, and language. Includes audit capabilities and is mapped as a JPA entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key identifier of the user.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key identifier of the user.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section data for the user.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section data for the user.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Gets the user's default language setting.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Assigns a list of groups to the user.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves the list of groups associated with the user.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the user.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the user.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the user is active.

methods.name: setLastAccess
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of last access.

methods.name: getLastAccess
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of last access.
